channel.description: الأكثر بحثًا اليوم — Trending searches today

item.title: Phillies' Playoff Dreams Fade as Rays Blank Philadelphia in Defensive Collapse
item.description: The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a devastating 2-0 loss to the Tampa Bay Rays, squandering a dominant 10-strikeout performance by pitcher Cristopher Sánchez and allowing the Arizona Diamondbacks to cut their playoff lead to just one game.

item.title: Oregon QB Dante Moore Exits USC Game After Violent Head Injury Sparks Controversy
item.description: Oregon quarterback Dante Moore was forced to leave the game against USC after suffering an apparent head injury from a controversial hit that immediately ignited outrage across social media.

item.title: No. 12 USC Faces Oregon Showdown in High-Stakes Coliseum Battle
item.description: Jayden Maiava and the 12th-ranked Trojans take on one of their toughest opponents this season when No. 12 USC clashes with Oregon at the Coliseum on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Undefeated Tulsa Faces Arkansas in High-Stakes Clash at Razorback Stadium
item.description: Undefeated Tulsa Golden Hurricane travel to Fayetteville for their biggest test of the season against Arkansas, which has dominated the matchup with a 19-game win streak since 1977.

item.title: إسبانيا تفوز على إنجلترا بثلاثة أهداف مقابل هدفين في دوري الأمم الأوروبية
item.description: حقق المنتخب الإسباني الفائز بكأس العالم فوزًا على نظيره الإنجليزي 3-2 في مباراة بدوري الأمم الأوروبية، بينما أهدر هاري كين ضربة جزاء في الشوط الثاني.

item.title: White Sox Shortstop Colson Montgomery Sets Infamous MLB Single-Season Strikeout Record
item.description: Colson Montgomery of the Chicago White Sox officially shattered baseball's most ignominious record, striking out 224 times in a single season and dethroning Mark Reynolds's 17-year-old mark.

item.title: Cruz Azul Targets Back-to-Back Title as Toluca Clash Looms Saturday
item.description: Cruz Azul coach Joel Huiqui openly admits the club is hungry for a second consecutive championship, with the critical Jornada 10 showdown against Toluca this Saturday marking a pivotal test in their Apertura 2026 campaign.

item.title: LSU Tigers Face Texas A&M in High-Stakes Saturday Showdown at Tiger Stadium
item.description: Thousands of college football fans descended on Baton Rouge Saturday as LSU and Texas A&M prepared for a pivotal matchup at Tiger Stadium, with tailgate crowds energizing the atmosphere ahead of kickoff.

item.title: Christian Edwards Delivers Stunning Third-Round TKO at UFC Vegas 121
item.description: Light heavyweight prospect Christian Edwards shocked Brazilian striker Rodolfo Bellato with a devastating third-round TKO victory at UFC Vegas 121 on Saturday, September 26, 2026, at the Meta Apex in Las Vegas.

item.title: إسبانيا تفوز على إنجلترا 3-2 في دوري الأمم الأوروبية
item.description: حققت إسبانيا فوزًا صعبًا على إنجلترا بثلاثة أهداف مقابل هدفين في مباراة مثيرة على ملعب ويمبلي بلندن ضمن منافسات دوري الأمم الأوروبية.

item.title: برنامج حساب المواطن يوضح خطوات إضافة تابع جديد والموعد المتوقع
item.description: كشف برنامج حساب المواطن عن آلية إضافة التابعين الجدد والمدة الزمنية اللازمة لدراسة أهليتهم ضمن الدورات المقبلة.

item.title: Harvest Moon Lights Up Sky Tonight With Rare Golden Saturn Alignment
item.description: The full Harvest Moon reaches peak brightness tonight, creating a stunning celestial display alongside golden Saturn—a viewing opportunity that won't repeat for another year.

item.title: Trump's Tariff War With Canada Devastates Maine Communities and U.S. Auto Sales
item.description: President Trump's escalating tariffs on Canada are triggering economic havoc across Maine and crushing American automakers, with U.S. vehicle sales in Canada plummeting to historic lows.

item.title: Kansas State Opens Big 12 Play Against Cincinnati in Primetime Showcase
item.description: The Wildcats face Cincinnati in a night game to launch their Big 12 conference schedule, with quarterback depth and key matchups shaping Saturday's showdown.

item.title: Georgia Tech Invades Stanford For Pivotal ACC Opener As Jackets Seek Redemption
item.description: Georgia Tech's struggling 1-2 squad travels to Stanford Saturday night to launch ACC conference play, seeking to reverse an early-season skid under head coach Brent Key.

item.title: Jon Watts Tapped to Direct Next Star Wars Movie for Lucasfilm's New Trilogy
item.description: The Spider-Man: No Way Home director is reportedly jumping from Marvel to helm a fresh Star Wars film as part of Simon Kinberg's upcoming Skywalker Saga continuation.

item.title: Rice Owls Battle Fresno State Bulldogs in Prime-Time College Football Clash
item.description: Rice University and Fresno State face off in a Saturday night college football showdown as both teams vie for early-season dominance on national television.

item.title: Padres' Playoff Push Hits Turbulence: Mize Injured, Musgrove Approaches Return
item.description: The Padres suffered a critical blow when ace Casey Mize landed on the injured list with a right ankle sprain, threatening their postseason rotation just as Joe Musgrove shows encouraging signs of recovery.

item.title: سيناريو جنوني في اللحظات الأخيرة.. العراق يحسم قمة الكويت في خليجي 27 بثلاثية تاريخية
item.description: في واحدة من أكثر مواجهات خليجي 27 إثارة، أسود الرافدين يحسمون الديربي أمام الكويت بثلاثية درامية قلبت موازين المجموعة في الدقائق القاتلة.

item.title: بهدف خيالي وتحطيم للأرقام.. ماذا يخبئ عمر مرموش في ليلة الحسم مع منتخب مصر؟
item.description: أنظار الملايين تتجه الليلة نحو عمر مرموش وهو يقود هجوم الفراعنة في مواجهة حاسمة، وسط ترقب لمواصلة توهجه الأوروبي وتحطيم أرقام قياسية جديدة.

item.title: شهادات البنك الأهلي تعود بفائدة 22% سنويًا.. كيف تحسب أرباحك من استثمارك؟
item.description: البنك الأهلي يطرح شهادات ادخار بفائدة تصل إلى 22% لمدة 3 سنوات، محققًا أعلى عائد محلي وسط اهتمام متزايد من المدخرين بأدوات الادخار المستقرة في مواجهة التوترات الاقتصادية.

item.title: إيجار بدلاً من الشراء.. كيف تحل مصر أزمة الإقبال على المدن الجديدة؟
item.description: وزارة الإسكان المصرية تطرح خيار الإيجار الذي ينتهي بالتملك كحل لجذب السكان للمدن الجديدة وسط تراجع الإقبال عليها.

item.title: Dramatic Odds Flip: Bryczek Shifts From Favorite to Underdog Against Vieira
item.description: Robert Bryczek's betting odds reversed spectacularly ahead of UFC Fight Night, as the middleweight contender faces Rodolfo Vieira in a pivotal Las Vegas clash.

item.title: Brazilian Light Heavyweight Rodolfo Bellato Returns to Octagon After Spine Surgery
item.description: After recovering from spine surgery, Brazilian fighter Rodolfo Bellato makes his UFC comeback against Christian Edwards at UFC Vegas 121, declaring himself fully healed and ready to exploit his opponent's weaknesses.

item.title: Southern Miss Clashes With Tulane in Fierce Battle for the Bell Renewal
item.description: The longtime rival schools renew their storied Battle for the Bell rivalry on Saturday night at Yulman Stadium in New Orleans, marking their 35th all-time meeting just over 100 miles apart.

item.title: Atlanta United Tests Squad Depth Against NYCFC in High-Stakes Playoff Push
item.description: Atlanta United faces New York City FC with Tata Martino ready to deploy Atlanta United 2 players as the teams battle for critical playoff positioning.

item.title: UNT Hosts Houston Christian in Senior Day Showdown Seeking Rebound
item.description: North Texas football returns home on Senior Day to face Houston Christian Saturday night, seeking momentum after recent struggles in a prime-time matchup.

item.title: Oregon State Travels to Sun Bowl for Critical September Finale Against UTEP Miners
item.description: Oregon State heads to El Paso for its final September matchup as the Beavers seek momentum heading into October conference play against UTEP at the Sun Bowl.

item.title: Texas A&M QB Marcel Reed Forced To Change Number After Doxxing By Kentucky Fan
item.description: Texas A&M quarterback Marcel Reed became the victim of a doxxing attack following the Aggies' loss to Kentucky, with his personal phone number leaked online by a fan, forcing him to change his contact information.

item.title: Latino Businesses Face Collapse As ICE Raids Trigger Economic Crisis Nationwide
item.description: A sweeping national campaign called "Compra Latino / Buy Latino" launches to rescue Hispanic-owned businesses devastated by widespread fear of Immigration and Customs Enforcement operations, while activists warn of rising consumer costs from labor shortages.

item.title: Nashville SC Hosts Short-Handed Toronto FC in Critical Supporters Shield Clash
item.description: Nashville SC, leading both the Supporters' Shield and Eastern Conference standings with eight matches remaining, faces a depleted Toronto FC side fighting for playoff survival in a high-stakes weekend showdown.

item.title: Real Salt Lake Faces Winless Drought Against Surging New England Revolution
item.description: Real Salt Lake remains without an MLS victory since the World Cup as they clash with high-flying New England Revolution on Sunday, with coach Mastroeni demanding immediate offensive breakthroughs.

item.title: Messi and Suárez Overhaul Coaching Staff at Joint Deportivo LSM Club Project
item.description: Luis Suárez and Lionel Messi's co-owned Deportivo LSM appointed former Nacional defender Álvaro Apólito as new manager after parting ways with their previous coach following a difficult first season in divisional competition.

item.title: Air Force Battles Nevada in High-Stakes College Football Showdown Saturday Night
item.description: Air Force faces Nevada on Saturday at 10:30 p.m. ET in a pivotal college football matchup broadcast live on FOX Sports 1, with the Wolf Pack seeking to close the series gap against the Falcons.

item.title: Golden Gophers Battle Huskies in Pivotal Week 4 Showdown Saturday Night
item.description: Minnesota and Washington clash in a critical college football matchup Saturday as both teams seek to strengthen their playoff positioning in Week 4 action.

item.title: الولايات المتحدة تواجه بيرو في مباراة ودية دولية
item.description: ستلعب الولايات المتحدة مباراة ودية ضد بيرو في 27 سبتمبر 2026، حيث يسعى كلا الفريقين لتحسين أدائهما.

item.title: الفنانة صابرين تحتفل بعقد قران نجلها نور
item.description: احتفلت الفنانة صابرين بعقد قران ابنها نور على فتاة من خارج الوسط الفني في أجواء عائلية هادئة بحضور الأهل والأصدقاء.

item.title: قائد القوات المشتركة يجتمع مع طارق صالح لإعادة ترتيب الأولويات اليمنية
item.description: الفريق السلمان يبحث مع عضو مجلس القيادة الرئاسي اليمني تعزيز الجاهزية العسكرية وتوحيد الجهود في ظل التطورات الميدانية الأخيرة.

item.title: 800 ألف ريال ضمان إلزامي لترخيص خدمات السفر والسياحة بالسعودية
item.description: أقرت وزارة السياحة السعودية اشتراط تقديم ضمان مالي يصل إلى 800 ألف ريال للحصول على ترخيص خدمات السفر والسياحة، بدءًا من 50 ألف ريال.

item.title: رافائيل مارکيز يخطو خطواته الأولى مدربًا للمكسيك أمام كولومبيا
item.description: انطلقت حقبة جديدة للمنتخب المكسيكي برئاسة رافائيل مارکيز في مواجهة ودية دولية استعدادًا لمونديال 2026 من ملعب ماريلاند بالولايات المتحدة.
